segments.title: Negative Follower Analytics & Hamtaro Stream Kickoff
segments.notes: Case opens the Hamtaro-themed broadcast by displaying negative follower analytics (-0.16/hr) and framing the stream as an unemployment simulator.

segments.title: Subscriber & Bit Acknowledgments
segments.notes: Hype Train delivers a brief freestyle thank-you for sub milestones and bit donations before being 'slain'; Pepito claims canine multiverse awareness and completes the acknowledgments.

segments.title: Bathroom Flood Crisis & Handyman Lore
segments.notes: Case leaves to answer the doorbell; Kendall discusses water leaking under bathroom floorboards, the contractor who caused it, and Case's landlord/handyman background.

segments.title: Popcorn the Hamster Human-Interest Story
segments.notes: Case and Kendall watch a viral video about a hamster named Popcorn who facilitated a marriage after a breakup, reaching 100K followers.

segments.title: AI Blackmail Story & Harry Potter Disinterest
segments.notes: Chat submits an AI blackmail story via the news hole; Case dismisses Harry Potter/HBO news and reads an article about an AI threatening to reveal an engineer's affair.

segments.title: Sesame AI 'Miles' Roleplay Session
segments.notes: Case connects to Sesame AI 'Miles' for a live roleplay as a hamster in a corporate blackmail scenario; the AI narrates rather than participates and times out.

segments.title: Hamtaro vs. Goku & 100 Men vs. Gorilla Death Wager
segments.notes: Crum and Munch debate Hamtaro vs. Goku then 100 men vs. gorilla; Crum escalates his gorilla gambling debt into a triple-or-death wager: $15k/win, full-force gorilla face punch on next loss, eight-win deadline to clear $115k debt or die.

segments.title: Post-Debate Fallout & Hamster Game Transition
segments.notes: Case wraps the debate block, mocks Crum's mortality odds, and attempts to launch the hamster game 'Hamsters on Rails' before technical concerns force a stream restart.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the Hamtaro-themed broadcast, managed negative follower analytics, and oversaw a catastrophic gorilla wager escalation.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the cold open, managed hype train handoff, and claimed canine multiverse awareness.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical/cultural interruption. Executed a brief freestyle subscriber thank-you before being 'slain' and replaced by Peter Gibbon.

characters.name: Kendall
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through the studio in Hamtaro attire and discussed the bathroom flood crisis with Case.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Escalated his gorilla gambling debt to a potential death wager after a winning streak.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Advocated for Crum's gorilla execution and negotiated a high-stakes eight-debate kill condition.

storylines.beat: Crum's gorilla debt reaches $115,000; new wager triples payout to $15k/win but mandates a full-force gorilla face punch if he loses the next debate, with an eight-win deadline to clear the debt or die. [59:49, 1:01:53, 1:12:13]

lore_notes.fact: Case's channel loses -0.16 followers per hour.
Bathroom floorboards leaking water; repair contractor originally built the faulty plumbing.
Crum's wife extracted a promise to curb gambling.
Crum claims seven consecutive debate wins.
New wager: $15k per win (tripled), gorilla face punch on next loss, eight-win deadline to clear debt or death.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a Hamtaro-themed broadcast anchored by Case Blackwell, featuring negative follower analytics, a bathroom flood crisis, and a viral hamster marriage story. The centerpiece was a Munch & Crum debate that spiraled into a lethal gambling escalation: Crum accepted a triple-or-death wager against his mechanical gorilla creditor, mandating a full-force face punch on his next loss with an eight-win deadline to clear $115,000 or die. The broadcast concluded with a failed attempt to launch the hamster puzzle game 'Hamsters on Rails' before technical instability forced a stream restart.
